symptom: `create external entities` from a $metadata that declares <edmx:Include Namespace="Org.OData.Capabilities.V1" Alias="Capabilities"/> and writes Term="Capabilities.InsertRestrictions": the entity imported as not creatable / deletable, and mx check 11.14 reported 4 x CE6630 ("marked Creatable=True in the OData service, but False in the app") plus CE0852 / CE9435 on the flows writing it (ako/mxcli#1977)
cause: ParseEdmx matched every annotation term by its full namespace (`case "Org.OData.Capabilities.V1.UpdateRestrictions"`) and never read edmx:Reference/Include aliases, so an aliased term matched nothing and was skipped silently — 12 terms (8 Capabilities, 4 Core) across entity sets, schema-level Annotations blocks, entity types and properties
file: mdl/types/edmx.go (normalizeAnnotationTerms, xmlReference/xmlInclude, Schema Alias); test mdl/types/edmx_vocabulary_alias_test.go
insight: Normalise at the boundary, once: rewriting each aliased term to its full namespace right after Unmarshal fixes every consumer, the six switch sites and any added later, where teaching each switch about aliases would leave the next one to forget. An undeclared prefix is left as written (the control), so nothing is guessed. A contract fixture is a local file next to the project (MetadataUrl: 'x.xml'); measured on fresh 11.14.0: base 6 errors, fix 0. Updatable stays No by design — Mendix's own Updatable does not follow UpdateRestrictions (cmd_contract.go), and mx check agrees.
